title: Great app, bad design
body: Works really well. Just doesn’t look as nice as the Atomic Habits app, although Daily Habits is available for a fraction of the price.
author: Evan T M

title: Thanks
body: Love the personal accountability it gives.
author: healthy poss

title: Very easy to use app that helps tracking habits
body:
I use the app to instil habits rather than break them but I can see how easily it can be used for either purpose.
Simple but great graphics, easy to use and gives good stats.
I like the prompts.
author: Mme Karen

title: Great app to keep me accountable
body: This app has been invaluable in keeping me accountable to do the positive things I need to do each day. I love it!
author: Lethborgs itunes

title: Not working
body: It doesn’t not sync properly with my iwatch, I select done when I complete the actions but at the next day every thing is unselected again! Also it always appears in my iwatch the action to be completed for the next day but it show no action in the current day! I wish I could ask a refund
author: diegochc16

title: Version for Mac please
body:
It would be good to have a Mac version as well, please. 
Otherwise, good to see an ongoing work on improving your applications. Thank you!
author: ozpol

title: Great for Routines
body: I do that use this as a habit breaking up but as a way to keep up with my daily routine which it is great for.
author: The cherry homemaker

title: Does not work (freezes) on iPhone 5
body: Disappointing as looks very promising. Not sure why it does not work as shouldn't be too resource intensive.
author: Prh_84

title: Does what it says it does
body: But that's about it. For strong people to break their strong habits it take a strong instrument of change. This app ain't it. Not aggressive enough in appearance nor behaviour.
author: PCDinSYD

title: Beautiful design & simple
body: I've assessed a number of habit trackers & selected this one. The Apple Watch app is far superior to other habit trackers.  Highly recommended.
author: Jayco_9

title: Excellent, simple, effective
body: App is perfect. I needed a simple app to track daily goals. This app is exactly what I was looking for and it is very beautiful design.
author: AnexCo192
